title: The Airpower We Need for Irregular Warfare
text:
Why does providing aircraft to partner forces so often fall short of building an effective air force? Retired Lieutenant General Anthony Rock, Michael Horowitz, and Tobias Switzer, an adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, join Kyle Atwell to examine the gap between acquiring technology and turning it into military power. Drawing on Switzer’s RAND report, Build Partner Airpower, Not Air Forces, the conversation explores what American air advisors learned in Iraq and Afghanistan and what future missions should do differently.
Listen to the full interview on Irregular Warfare Initiative.
